propositions: Plan review must classify every acceptance-criterion checkbox as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested and produce criterion-specific evidence for the classification
Externally verifiable criteria without the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag must produce findings naming the required syntax; criteria with the exact tag must be accepted
Codebase-verifiable criteria carrying [operator-attested] must produce findings explaining ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof; untagged equivalents must be accepted
Criteria combining repository proof and outside-world proof must not be silently assigned one evidence kind; authors must split them into independently certifiable criteria
High-confidence misclassification findings must participate in normal blocking policy while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory
